canonical_relabeling: erase site/tag identities, map current front packet to FRONT_SITE, retain declared ingress labels and exact F components
large_integer_lane_gate: only after exact phase transfer theorem is established may huge integer component states M*e_p be stress-tested
mutation_tests: change recruitment index only -> F,p unchanged
cyclic site relabeling -> F,p unchanged after canonical relabeling
common Cartesian/raw-history multiplicity rescaling without source-support change -> F,p unchanged
permuting lineage identities inside a phase class -> F,p unchanged
changing an actual current ingress class -> corresponding F component and possibly p changes
not_a_counter: p is a current relational ingress phase in a 3-cycle and repeats after three successful relays; it is not monotone, not elapsed transfer count, and contains no remaining-range budget
permutation_covariance: permuting source-tag identities within any ingress class leaves F and p unchanged

semantics.F: F=(F_H,F_V,F_V_INV), exact current number of source-tag lineages at the relay-front packet by CURRENT_INGRESS class H,V,V_INV
semantics.one_phase_class: reachable real-I3 positive class has exactly one positive phase component and total phase support 1
semantics.phase_code: p=0 iff F_H>0 only; p=1 iff F_V>0 only; p=2 iff F_V_INV>0 only
semantics.reconstruction: current packet, current ingress labels, and exact source-support counts only; no history/tag identity/time
semantics.resident: resident tag is START at the same packet and is not counted in F because it has no relay-phase ingress yet

transport_automaton.certificate_target: each word ends at H*x with the same phase code p; phase 1 uses frozen relational commutation H V = V H; V V_INV cancels
transport_automaton.macro_transport: three adjacency transitions advance one declared H relation while preserving p
